<script>
        $(function () {
            $('.showmore-btn').each(function () {
                var origText = $(this).children().text(),
                    newText = 'Mostra altro',
                    origHeight = $(this).prev().css("height"),
                    newHeight = 170;

                function toggle(el) {
                    el.prev().css('height', el.prev().css("height") != origHeight ? origHeight : newHeight);
                    el.children().text(el.children().text() != origText ? origText : newText);
                }

                $(this).on('click', function (e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    toggle($(this));
                });
                toggle($(this));
            });
        });
	</script>
<script src="/js/clipboard.min.js?v=1"></script>
<script>
		var clipboard = new ClipboardJS('.clipboardjs');

		clipboard.on('success', function(e) {
			document.querySelector('.menu .menu-htmlcode__copyconfirm--success').dataset.status = 'show';
			document.querySelector('.menu .menu-htmlcode__copyconfirm--error').dataset.status = 'hide';
		});

		clipboard.on('error', function(e) {
			document.querySelector('.menu .menu-htmlcode__copyconfirm--success').dataset.status = 'hide';
			document.querySelector('.menu .menu-htmlcode__copyconfirm--error').dataset.status = 'show';
		});
	</script>
